algorithms.direct: Create project; create each record in topological order with known parent and dependency IDs plus all required fields; one final flat all-record list.
algorithms.batch: Create project; one parse_prd with all safe paragraphs, estimateComplexity=true, defaultPriority=5; flat all-record list supplies IDs. For full-field cases, update every record once with priority/complexity/hours/tags/status and required links, without resending preserved name/details; final flat list. Default-compatible flat case needs no updates and its first list is final.
algorithms.direct_deferred: Full-field cases only: create project; create all records with full scalar metadata but without links; record IDs from creation receipts; update only parent/dependency links for records that require them; final flat list. Avoids treating fully dependency-ordered direct creation as the only ordinary strategy.

ids: Extract project/task IDs only from native receipts and flat list, never from privileged state for subsequent calls. Disk state is evaluation-only.
acceptance: All required names, complete details, priority, complexity, estimatedHours, tags, status, completed=false, parent/dependency topology and levels match the identical generated input in both paths. Exclude only random IDs/timestamps and map references to predefined keys. No duplicates/empty IDs; all list IDs actually present exactly once.
metrics: theoretical dependency waves with unlimited same-response independent native calls
wave_definition: Project creation is one wave. Direct creation waves are the longest parent/dependency path plus final inspection. Deferred direct has project, one creation wave, one link-update wave, one final inspection. Batch has project/import/ID-list plus optional one metadata/link update wave and final inspection. This is a dependency lower bound for each specified algorithm with unbounded argument capacity, NOT actual actor rounds, an optimum over every possible hybrid, or a claim that a 4096-token response fits all calls.
cost_handling: Dedicated native-only ledger records 0 model calls/tokens/USD; no old model ledger touched. Calls and stdout/stderr/state always retained.
decision_rule: If any required state differs, no equivalence claim for that case. If full-field shallow path costs more calls/waves, reject a general batch-is-cheaper claim. If chain reduces waves but increases calls, retain only a structure-conditional possibility; do not infer actor adoption or task success. No extra sampling or new model experiment follows automatically.
failure_handling: Persist each response/state before checks. Stop on transport/native error without rerunning completed calls. Record unexecuted cells. A checker/driver defect may be fixed against retained responses; no fresh native data to replace a failed result.
boundaries: Original model/provider/actor/native/budgets/rubrics unchanged. No benchmark question/answer/scored trajectory in these inputs or any updater. No377 route. All synthetic result IDs separate from original benchmark. This is not a new candidate generation or independent validation.
input_selection: Three predeclared structural regimes; node counts3/6 fixed for small native diagnosis, no actor success target, no benchmark exclusion or simplified replacement.
